study type: Prospective cohort study (sub-study of a randomized controlled trial)
outcome: Breastfeeding outcomes (exclusive breastfeeding, partial breastfeeding, breastfeeding cessation) at 2, 6, and 12 months
cohort: 635 women with uncomplicated term births who intended to breastfeed
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding declined significantly between 2 and 6 months postpartum, with several factors including caesarean birth, low milk supply, and early introduction of solids associated with breastfeeding cessation.
